optimizedContext.value:
# Change Status

## Rules

- Signature: `specd change status <name> [--implementation] [--format text|json|toon]`.
- Invoke `GetStatus` directly; never call `RefreshImplementationTracking` or `ImplementationDetector`; use default refresh policy.
- Drafted changes (`draftView`): render read-only, mark drafted (`isDrafted: true`), never output actionable mutating transitions.
- Missing change: exit 1 with stderr `error:`.
- Human/text mode: render display state (`complete-with-drift`, canonical review states over drift-only); missing remains `missing`. Structured mode includes canonical and display states; top-level `artifactDag[].state` uses display state.
- `artifactDag`: structured output includes `hasTasks` boolean per entry. Text DAG prints `[hasTasks - N/M done]` when completion exists, else `[hasTasks]`; details append `tasks: N/M`.
- Compare recorded schema name/version with `GetStatus.lifecycle.schemaInfo`; mismatch warns to stderr and exits 0; null skips warning.
- Structured `schema`: includes name, version, topologically ordered `artifactDag` (`id`, `scope`, `optional`, `requires`, `children`, `hasTasks`, `output`). Use cached `schema.artifactDag()`, definition `requires`, `childrenOf(id)`, `roots()`; `hasTasks` checks explicit flag or `taskCompletionCheck`.
- Text DAG: use same root/child order and display states; render each convergent artifact id at most once, referencing repeats.
- `--implementation`: render structured projection from `sdk:build-implementation-review` via `GetStatus` (tracked `open|resolved|ignored` files, links, symbol statuses). Do not query graph or implement fallback policy; never mutate tracking/sidecars.
- Text output order: top info block (name, state; omit standalone specs list), DAG/details, then "specs and dependencies" from manifest `specDependsOn`. Structured output includes top-level `specDependsOn`.
- Serialize all schema-declared artifacts, including absent files.

## Constraints

- `effectiveStatus` includes dependency cascading.
- CLI serializes `GetStatus` projections; never re-derive via `SchemaRegistry`, config show, or local lifecycle logic.
- Symbol resolution provided exclusively via SDK; CLI does not recompute.
